queries: SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS average_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) AS per_rating

SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_rating_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_rating_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) AS per_rating

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS average_length, AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM rating_averages
